Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.dose_acre: 20 g Streptocycline + 500 g Copper Oxychloride in 200 L water
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.knapsack_16l: 1.6 g Streptocycline + 40 g Copper Oxychloride per 16L tank
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.organic: Spray 5% Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE) or fresh cow dung slurry supernatant (20 kg in 200 L water).
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.cultural: Drain excess water from paddies; suspend topdressing of urea / nitrogen fertilizers immediately.
Rice___Bacterial_leaf_blight.safety: Keep cattle and grazing animals out of treated paddies for at least 7 days. Wear gloves.

Rice___Brown_spot.dose_acre: 500 g Mancozeb or 200 ml Propiconazole in 200 L water
Rice___Brown_spot.knapsack_16l: 40 g Mancozeb or 16 ml Propiconazole per 16L tank
Rice___Brown_spot.organic: Foliar spray with Pseudomonas fluorescens @ 10 g/L or 10% cow urine extract.
Rice___Brown_spot.cultural: Apply muriate of potash (K) to correct potassium deficiency in light soils.
Rice___Brown_spot.safety: Avoid spraying against wind. Wash hands and face with soap after spraying.

Sugarcane___RedRot.chemical: Carbendazim 50% WP sett dip / Thiophanate-Methyl 70% WP
Sugarcane___RedRot.dose_acre: 1.0 g/L sett dip solution; 250 g/acre whorl drench
Sugarcane___RedRot.organic: Dip setts in Trichoderma viride culture (10 g/L) for 20 minutes before planting.
Sugarcane___RedRot.cultural: Uproot and burn diseased clumps immediately; ensure drainage trenches to eliminate standing water.
Sugarcane___RedRot.safety: Wear protective apron and face shield; do not inhale chemical powder.

Banana___Sigatoka.chemical: Propiconazole 25% EC or Propineb 70% WP with mineral oil
Banana___Sigatoka.dose_acre: 200 ml Propiconazole in 200 L water with 1% spray oil
Banana___Sigatoka.knapsack_16l: 16 ml Propiconazole + 15 ml mineral oil per 16L tank
Banana___Sigatoka.organic: Pre-monsoon spraying with 1% Bordeaux mixture or 5% neem oil emulsion.
Banana___Sigatoka.cultural: De-leaf spotted lower leaves and bury them outside the plantation.
Banana___Sigatoka.safety: Wear face visor and waterproof gloves; suspend spraying in dense shade during high winds.

Coconut___Leaf_Spot.chemical: Hexaconazole 5% EC (Root Feeding) or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP
Coconut___Leaf_Spot.dose_acre: Root feeding with 10 ml Hexaconazole in 100 ml water per palm
Coconut___Leaf_Spot.knapsack_16l: 32 ml Hexaconazole per 16L tank for crown drench
Coconut___Leaf_Spot.organic: Root feeding with Pseudomonas fluorescens (10 g/100 ml water) + Neem cake 5 kg/palm.
Coconut___Leaf_Spot.cultural: Apply balanced fertilizers: 500g N, 320g P, 1200g K per palm annually.
Coconut___Leaf_Spot.safety: Use climbing safety harness for crown operations; do not harvest tender coconuts during waiting period.

Tomato___Early_blight.chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole SC
Tomato___Early_blight.dose_acre: 500 g Mancozeb or 200 ml Azoxystrobin combo in 200 L water
Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Foliar spray with Trichoderma viride @ 5 g/L or 1% Bordeaux mixture.
Tomato___Early_blight.cultural: Prune lower leaves touching wet soil; stake tomato vines; avoid overhead irrigation.
Tomato___Early_blight.safety: Do not spray in morning hours when honeybees are pollinating flowers.

Tomato___Late_blight.dose_acre: 500 g to 600 g in 200 L water
Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Prophylactic 1% Bordeaux mixture before cool, foggy weather.
Tomato___Late_blight.cultural: Remove and incinerate blighted haulms immediately.
Tomato___Late_blight.safety: Wear respirator mask and chemical eye goggles.

Potato___Late_blight.organic: Trichoderma seed tuber treatment before planting.
Potato___Late_blight.cultural: Earth up soil high around ridges to prevent rainwash from carrying spores to tubers.

Rice___Leaf_smut.chemical: Copper Oxychloride 50% WP or Mancozeb 75% WP
Rice___Leaf_smut.organic: Foliar spray with botanical neem oil 0.3% (3 ml/L with soap emulsifier).
Rice___Leaf_smut.cultural: Avoid excess nitrogen; remove infected stubbles after harvest.
Rice___Leaf_smut.safety: Standard knapsack protective clothing, goggles, and dust mask.

Sugarcane___Rust.dose_acre: 500 g Mancozeb or 200 ml Propiconazole in 200 L water
Sugarcane___Rust.organic: Foliar spray of 5% cow urine extract + 1% neem seed oil.
Sugarcane___Rust.cultural: Plant rust-resistant cultivars; ensure proper furrow drainage.

Banana___Cordana.dose_acre: 500 g Mancozeb or 200 g Carbendazim in 200 L water
Banana___Cordana.organic: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture before monsoon onset.
Banana___Cordana.cultural: Remove infected lower leaves; widen plant spacing for aeration.
Banana___Cordana.safety: Wear eye protection and face respirator mask.

Background_without_leaves.organic: Please point camera at a real agricultural crop leaf.
Background_without_leaves.cultural: Ensure leaf is centered and well lit in the viewfinder.
Background_without_leaves.safety: Keep fingers and clutter out of the camera frame.
